New: Jaylen Brown is eligible to sign a one-year contract extension with the Sixers.

If there is no extension this offseason, Brown would become eligible to sign a three-year extension next offseason.

Brown currently has three years left on his contract. www.phillyvoice.com/sixers-offic...

media.title: Sixers and Jaylen Brown eligible to negotiate one-year contract extension
media.description: Jaylen Brown is owed just over $185 million over the next three seasons. Soon after trading for him, the Sixers are now allowed to offer Brown a massive one-year extension.
